questions.stem: 在台灣西部外海，許多風力發電機（wind turbines）已被建在漁民賴以維生的漁場上。
questions.answer: Off the west coast of Taiwan, many wind turbines have been constructed on fishing grounds that fishermen rely on for a living.
accepted_answers: Off Taiwan's west coast, a lot of wind turbines have been built in fishing areas which fishermen depend on to make a living.
In the waters off Taiwan's west coast, many wind turbines have been installed on the fishing grounds on which fishermen depend for a living.

關係代名詞子句（that fishermen depend on）

questions.stem: 面對環保團體的批評，風場業者承諾保護白海豚，而白海豚已瀕臨絕種。
questions.answer: Faced with criticism from environmental groups, wind farm companies have promised to protect white dolphins, which are already nearly extinct.
accepted_answers: Facing criticism from environmental groups, wind farm developers have promised to protect white dolphins, which are already on the verge of extinction.
Faced with environmental groups' criticism, the wind farm companies promised to protect white dolphins, which are already in danger of dying out.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（, which are …）

1.explanation_zh: 「在台灣西部外海」是台灣西岸外面的海上，英文用介系詞 off（在…外海）：Off the west coast of Taiwan，不要逐字寫成 outside 或 west outside sea。「許多風力發電機已被建在…」：風力發電機是被建造的，「已」表示到現在已經完成，用完成式被動 many wind turbines have been built on …。「漁民賴以維生的漁場」修飾語很長，英文用關係子句放在名詞後：fishing grounds that fishermen depend on for a living，depend on 的 on 要留在子句裡（或寫 on which fishermen depend …）。「漁場」是 fishing grounds，不是 fish farms（養殖場）。
1.strategy_zh: 「在…外海」用 off the coast of …；「已被…」先想完成式被動 have been + p.p.；「某人賴以維生的＋名詞」用 N + (that) + S + depend on for a living。
hints: 切成四段：在台灣西部外海／許多風力發電機（wind turbines）已被建在／漁民賴以維生的／漁場上
標的詞彙：west（西部的）、coast（海岸）、build（建造）、fishing（捕魚的）、ground（場所）、fisherman（漁民）、depend（依賴）、living（生計）
句型框架：Off the west coast of Taiwan, many + N + have been constructed (built) on + N + (that) + S + rely (depend) on for a living.

2.explanation_zh: 「面對環保團體的批評」和後面的主詞「業者」是同一個，用分詞構句 Faced with criticism from environmental groups（或 Facing criticism …；不能寫 Facing with）。「承諾保護」是 promise to protect。「而白海豚已瀕臨絕種」是補充說明前面的白海豚，用非限定關係子句 , which are already nearly extinct（on the verge of extinction 也可以）；which 指複數的 dolphins，動詞用 are，逗號後不能用 that。
2.strategy_zh: 句首「面對／看到…」和主要子句同一個主詞時，用分詞構句；「而＋前面提過的名詞＋…」補充說明時，用 , which …。
hints: 切成四段：面對環保團體的批評／風場業者承諾保護／白海豚，而白海豚已／瀕臨絕種
標的詞彙：face（面對）、criticism（批評）、environmental（環保的）、group（團體）、wind（風）、company（業者）、promise（承諾）、protect（保護）、dolphin（海豚）、extinct（絕種的）
句型框架：Faced with + N, S + have promised to VR + N, which are already + adj.

traps.literal_error: In the west outside sea of Taiwan, many wind turbines have been built on fishing grounds that fishermen depend on for a living.
traps.explanation_zh: 「外海」不是 outside sea；英文用介系詞 off 表示「在（海岸）外的海上」：off the west coast of Taiwan。

traps.literal_error: Off the west coast of Taiwan, many wind turbines have been built on fishermen's living fishing grounds.
traps.explanation_zh: 「漁民賴以維生的漁場」修飾語在前，英文要改成後位的關係子句 fishing grounds (that) fishermen depend on for a living；逐字堆在名詞前意思不清楚。

bonus.text: Built on fishing grounds that fishermen depend on for a living are many of the wind turbines off Taiwan's west coast.
bonus.explanation_zh: 把過去分詞片語 Built on … 移到句首、主詞放到句尾（倒裝），強調風力發電機蓋在哪裡；這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「在台灣西部外海」用介系詞 off：Off the west coast of Taiwan；「已被建在…」用完成式被動 have been built on；「漁民賴以維生的漁場」改成後位的關係子句 fishing grounds (that) fishermen depend on for a living，介系詞 on 不能省。
1.notes_zh: 評分說明：第 1 部分「在台灣西部外海」Off the west (western) coast of Taiwan、Off Taiwan's west coast、Off western Taiwan，或 In the waters (sea) off …、In the waters west of Taiwan（放句首或句尾都可以）；寫 outside、in the west sea 不給分。第 2 部分「許多風力發電機已被建在」many／a lot of／a large number of (offshore) wind turbines + have (already) been built／constructed／installed／set up／put up／erected／placed（完成式被動）；風力發電機的英文題目已經給了，這一部分看的是完成式被動與主詞動詞一致。第 3 部分「漁民賴以維生的」(that／which) fishermen（fishers）+ depend on／rely on + for a living／for their living／for their livelihood／to make (earn) a living／to survive，關代可以省略；也可寫 on which fishermen depend (rely) for a living，或 where fishermen make (earn) a living（where 後面不能再接 on）。第 4 部分「漁場上」on／in (the) fishing grounds、in (the) fishing areas（waters、zones）；fish farms 是養殖場，不給分。

traps.literal_error: Facing with criticism from environmental groups, wind farm companies have promised …
traps.explanation_zh: face 是及物動詞，主動寫 Facing criticism，被動寫 Faced with criticism；Facing with 兩種都不是。

traps.literal_error: …white dolphins, which are already on the verge of extinct.
traps.explanation_zh: 「絕種」在 on the verge of 後面要用名詞 extinction；用形容詞要寫 nearly extinct／endangered。詞性弄錯是常見失分點。

bonus.text: Under fire from environmental groups, wind farm companies have vowed to protect white dolphins, whose numbers have dwindled to the brink of extinction.
bonus.explanation_zh: under fire（遭受批評）、vow（誓言）、whose numbers have dwindled（數量已銳減）是進階寫法，whose 一樣是非限定關係子句。這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「面對…」和主要子句的主詞（業者）相同，改成分詞構句 Faced with …／Facing …；「而白海豚已瀕臨絕種」補充說明前面的白海豚，用非限定關係子句 , which are already nearly extinct，不必重複主詞。
2.notes_zh: 評分說明：第 1 部分「面對環保團體的批評」Faced with／Facing + criticism from environmental groups（environmental groups' criticism、criticism from environmentalists／environmental organizations／conservation groups 也可以）；Facing with 不給分。第 2 部分「風場業者承諾保護」(the) wind farm companies／developers／operators、wind power companies + have promised／promised／have pledged／have vowed to protect（have committed to protecting 也可以）。第 3 部分「白海豚，而白海豚已」(the) (Chinese) white dolphins, which are (already／now) …；which 指前面的白海豚，複數用 are；把白海豚當一個物種寫成單數 the (Chinese) white dolphin 時接 , which is (already) …；逗號後用 that 或 they are 不給分。第 4 部分「瀕臨絕種」nearly (almost) extinct、on the verge (brink、edge) of extinction、in danger of extinction（dying out）、close to extinction、at risk of extinction、facing extinction、threatened with extinction、(critically) endangered、an endangered species 都給分。

1.translation: Off the west coast of Taiwan, many wind turbines have been built on the fishing grounds that fishermen depend on for a living.
1.explanation_zh: 「外海」用 off the coast；「已被建」用現在完成式被動 have been built；「漁民賴以維生的漁場」用關係子句 that fishermen depend on for a living（也可 on which fishermen rely for their livelihood）。

2.translation: Faced with criticism from environmental groups, wind farm operators have promised to protect white dolphins, which are already on the verge of extinction.
2.explanation_zh: 「面對……」用分詞構句 Faced with（主詞是業者，被批評，故用過去分詞；也可 Facing）；「承諾保護」用 promise to V；「而白海豚已瀕臨絕種」是補充說明，用非限定關係子句 , which are already on the verge of extinction（也可 which are already endangered）。

1.translation: Off the western coast of Taiwan, many wind turbines have been built on the fishing grounds that fishermen depend on for their living.
1.explanation_zh: 「在台灣西部外海」用 Off the western coast of Taiwan；「已被建在」是現在完成式被動 have been built；「漁民賴以維生的漁場」用關係子句 that fishermen depend on for their living（depend on ... for a living）。

2.translation: Faced with criticism from environmental groups, wind farm operators have promised to protect white dolphins, which are on the verge of extinction.
2.explanation_zh: 「面對…的批評」用過去分詞構句 Faced with；「承諾」用 promise to V（現在完成式，表示承諾仍有效）；「而白海豚已瀕臨絕種」用非限定關係子句 which are on the verge of extinction。「白海豚」的英文名稱（white dolphins／Chinese white dolphins）在中文題目沒有明確指定，我取最直白的 white dolphins，所以信心 medium。
